[[File:Stakes.png|thumb|200px|All of the stakes (including 2 unreleased ones)]]
There are 8 '''stakes''' in [[Balatro]], which become cumulatively more difficult. Each new stake modifier is added onto the previous ones, making it more challenging as you progress through the stakes.

In order to unlock the next stake for each unique deck, you must complete a run on the current highest unlocked stake for each specific deck individually. For example, you must complete the White Stake for the {{D|Red}}, before you can unlock the Red Stake for the Red Deck. You will not have unlocked the Red Stake for the {{D|Blue}}, you must first complete the White Stake with the Blue Deck in order to do so.

By finishing a stake with a [[Jokers|Joker]] on the Ante 8 [[Blinds|Showdown Blind]], you will get a {{Sticker|White|name=}} [[Stickers|Stake sticker]] on said Joker, with the corresponding Stake color you completed the run on. This also applies to the [[Deck]] that was used. By turning on the "display stake sticker during run" in the settings, it will display all stake stickers during your run.

[[Challenge Decks]] can only be played on the White Stake.

== List of stakes ==
The 8 stakes, listed in the order that they are unlocked. Note that each stake applies the modifiers of all previous stakes.

| Gold Stake
| 30% chance for Jokers in shops or booster packs to have a [[Stickers|Rental sticker]] (Costs {{Money|3}} per round, can be bought for {{Money|1}})
''The first Soul card in a Gold [[seed]] will give a Legendary Joker that doesn't yet have a Gold Sticker, which will help with the Completionist++ achievement.''

== Trivia ==
* In an interview with Bloomberg, [[LocalThunk]] has confirmed that he plans to change the blue stake in the [[Updates|1.1 Update]].<ref>{{Cite web|last=Schreier|first=Jason|title=Maker of Smash Indie Hit 'Balatro' Talks About What's Next|url=https://www.bloomberg.com/news/newsletters/2025-02-07/maker-of-smash-indie-hit-balatro-talks-about-what-s-next|accessdate=29 March, 2025|archivedate=February 7, 2025|archiveurl=https://archive.is/FwBtY}}</ref>
*The unused stake in the game files with the joker face may have been named "Jimbo Stake", as that is the name of the [https://steamdb.info/app/2379780/communityitems/#item-class-1 foil badge for Balatro on Steam]. LocalThunk has stated that this stake image was created "just for fun".<ref>''"No that [unused Joker Stake] was just for fun" - LocalThunk [https://discord.com/channels/1116389027176787968/1116389027675906110/1356501286463471737 in the Balatro Discord]''</ref>

== Update History ==
{{Update_history|update=
'''{{patch|1.0.1f}}'''
*Orange Stake
**Booster Packs cost {{Money|1}} more per [[Blinds|Ante]] -> Jokers have 30% chance to have a [[Stickers|Perishable sticker]]
*Gold Stake
**-1 hand size -> Jokers have 30% chance to have a [[Stickers|Rental sticker]]

'''{{patch|1.0.0h}}'''
* Stakes above White Stake were added to the game: Red, Green, Black, Blue, Purple, Orange, and Gold Stake
}}
